post.originalText:
Four AI models. One prompt: “build the Eiffel Tower.”🗼 
The cheapest one made the most convincing tower.

Kimi K3.1: $2.04 · 8 mins
GPT-6 Astra: $7.45 · 8 mins
Gemini 4 Argon: $6.10 · 9 mins
Opus 5.5: $8.95 · 10 mins
Opus cost over 4x more than Kimi and took longer.
What I noticed:
→ Kimi: the slimmest, most elegant silhouette, with the right taper and proportions
→ Opus: the richest scene, with the lawns, trees and deep-blue sky
→ Gemini: soft fluffy clouds, but a stockier tower
→ GPT: the finest lattice, delicate but a little see-through
Price clearly didn’t buy accuracy in this test.

Which one looks closest to the real thing?
